description: Check whether a lower price found after booking qualifies for the booking site's best price guarantee, using the same rules as the HotelRefund Refund Report: same-site drops, sites that ended their guarantee (Hotels.com; Expedia for newer bookings), currency mismatch, a price that is not actually lower, and the four matching conditions. Returns a verdict, the claim deadline (date, rule and days left), how the site pays out, the difference, and — with tracking_id — whether HotelRefund's timestamped Agoda records cover the same dates. No personal data is needed or accepted.

booked_date.description: Date the booking was made, YYYY-MM-DD (decides old Expedia bookings).

conditions_match.description: What the user has confirmed about the lower offer. Anything not true is reported as unconfirmed.

public_rate.description: Not a member, app-only, coupon or package rate.

language.description: Language of the verdict text: en (default), ko, ja or zh.

lower_currency.description: ISO currency of lower_total (defaults to paid_currency).

lower_price_site.description: Where the lower price was seen.

lower_total.description: Total of the lower offer for the same stay, taxes included.

paid_total.description: Total paid for the stay, taxes included.

tracking_id.description: Optional HotelRefund tracking for the same stay — its recorded prices are summarized as independent evidence.

name: check_refund_claim
title: Check a best price guarantee claim
